leadText:
A Mystery Man (Japanese: Mystery Man or なぞのせいねん Mystery Man) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in , though it was originally translated as Mysticalman in the English version of Pokémon Crystal. Two important non-player characters have had this class, both of which are, as the name implies, mysterious men. In Crystal Version, Eusine had the title of "Mysticalman", but it was changed to the later translation of "Mystery Man" in . Ardos has this Trainer class in during his cutscene battle with Zook, before his affiliation with Cipher is known. For his battles with the , however, his true class of is used.

Under this class, Ardos only reveals one member of his powerful team, his . Eusine keeps a varied team, two thirds of which have some connection to mystical powers. He is searching for the Legendary Pokémon .

This Trainer class is also given to the character , as portrayed by Terrence in parts two and three of The Giant Woman! Series.
